title: Dreamy Snow Escape: Why Thajiwas Glacier is Sonmarg’s Top Attraction
content:
Thajiwas Glacier - Magical Snow Paradise in Sonmarg You Can’t Miss

Hidden in the heart of Kashmir, Thajiwas Glacier is one of the most breathtaking snow destinations in India. Surrounded by snowy mountains, lush meadows, and fresh mountain air, this glacier is a dream place for nature lovers and adventure seekers.

If you want to see real snow, enjoy pony rides, and click Instagram-worthy pictures, Thajiwas Glacier in Sonmarg should definitely be on your travel bucket list for 2026.

Why Thajiwas Glacier is So Famous

Thajiwas Glacier is famous because it offers snow almost all year round, even during summer months. Located just 3 km from Sonmarg, it is the most popular attraction for tourists visiting Kashmir. The glacier looks like a magical white world with flowing streams, frozen ice sheets, and stunning mountain views. Whether you love photography, trekking, or simply want to enjoy snowfall, this place gives a truly unforgettable experience.

Location of Thajiwas Glacier

Thajiwas Glacier is located in Sonmarg, Jammu & Kashmir, about 80 km from Srinagar.
You can reach Sonmarg by taxi or cab from Srinagar, and from there you can either trek or take a pony ride to the glacier. The journey itself is scenic with green valleys, rivers, and snow-covered peaks all around.

Best Things to Do at Thajiwas Glacier

  •  Enjoy Snow Activities : You can enjoy snowboarding, sledging, and playing in fresh snow. It feels like a mini Switzerland in India.
  •  Pony Ride Experience : The most popular way to reach the glacier is by pony ride. It’s fun, adventurous, and gives amazing valley views.
  •  Trekking Adventure : Adventure lovers can trek to Thajiwas Glacier. The trek is easy to moderate and full of natural beauty.
  •  Photography & Reels : Every corner here is Instagram-worthy. Snow mountains, frozen waterfalls, and scenic landscapes make it perfect for photos and reels.
  •  Enjoy Kashmiri Maggi & Tea : Small stalls near the glacier serve hot Maggi, kahwa, and tea - perfect in cold weather.

Best Time to Visit Thajiwas Glacier

The best time to visit depends on what you want:

  • April to June: Snow even in summer, best for sightseeing
  • July to September: Green meadows and glacier views
  • October to February: Heavy snowfall & winter wonderland

For snow lovers, May and June are the most popular months.

How to Reach Thajiwas Glacier

  • By Air: Nearest airport - Srinagar Airport
  • By Road: Srinagar to Sonmarg (2.5 hours drive)
  • From Sonmarg: Pony ride or 1-2 hour trek to glacier

Why Thajiwas Glacier Should Be on Your Bucket List

If you dream of touching snow, seeing majestic mountains, and enjoying peaceful nature, Thajiwas Glacier is a must-visit destination. It offers adventure, beauty, and calmness all in one place. A trip to Kashmir feels incomplete without visiting this snowy paradise. Once you visit, the magical charm of Thajiwas Glacier will stay in your heart forever.

faqs.question: Where is Thajiwas Glacier located?
faqs.answer: Thajiwas Glacier is located in Sonmarg, Jammu & Kashmir, around 80 km from Srinagar and about 3 km from Sonmarg market.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Thajiwas Glacier?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit is from April to June for snow and pleasant weather. Winter months (December-February) are best for heavy snowfall lovers.

faqs.question: Is there snow at Thajiwas Glacier in summer?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can see snow even in summer months like May and June, which makes it one of the most popular snow points in Kashmir.

faqs.question: What is the pony ride cost for Thajiwas Glacier?
faqs.answer: Pony ride usually costs between ₹800 to ₹1500 per person (price may vary by season and bargaining).

faqs.question: Can we walk or trek to Thajiwas Glacier?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can trek to the glacier. It takes around 1-2 hours and is an easy to moderate trek with beautiful scenic views.
